name: NACL 2027
overview: North American Challengers League 2027, LCS's confirmed Tier 2 regional ecosystem. Kairos Academy Blue is the organization's official active NACL Tier 2 representative, distinct from Kairos Gaming (LCS Main) and Kairos Academy White (developmental, non-NACL); no automatic promotion exists between them. Kairos Academy Blue may qualify internationally without automatic promotion to the LCS Main roster. The NACL regional field is standardized to 8 active teams for 2027; most participating franchises are tracked in the pre-Worlds 2026 real-world reference scene as Kairos Universe fictional 2027 regional-membership status, not as Kairos Universe internal canon teams, and are not listed in participantTeamIds here.
